title: Qt: Use modern signals+slots in more places

notes.body:
I ran into this earlier when looking at the same thing (!18196)

https://www.qt.io/blog/whats-new-in-qmetatype-qvariant

https://forum.qt.io/topic/129940/qt6-regression-with-qabstractlistmodel-type-argument-of-q_property-or-q_declare_metatype-t-must-be-fully-defined

Note from the former:
> "Lastly, there are rare cases where you have an intentionally opaque pointer. In that case, you need to use Q_DECLARE_OPAQUE_POINTER is used.

> This is certainly suboptimal, though in our experience properties with incomplete types are not that common. In addition, we’re currently investigating extending our tooling support to make at least the detecion of this issue automatic."

It seems like this change, or perhaps some others, in Qt 6.5 make it a little easier to use forward declared pointers:
https://github.com/qt/qtbase/commit/3695b35dfc427f274e55f8e2a6a9876deb52f1b4

But that doesn't help for distros on 6.4 and earlier.
